verdict.rationale: Caching resolved actions or generated code for deterministic replay is a fair axis for a browser-automation agent, but the evidence pack never documents action caching, script generation, or replay. Sessions that reuse a live browser, saved login profiles, and a waitlisted SUPERFAST mode are adjacent features, not cached deterministic replay, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can cache resolved actions or generated code so repeat runs replay deterministically at lower cost and latency than re-prompting the LLM
